message.content:
Based on the image provided, here is a complete, detailed description of the flyer:

### **Overall Design and Layout**
*   **Style:** The flyer has a modern, premium, and professional aesthetic. It uses a "luxury" color palette of deep navy blue (background) and metallic gold/yellow (text and accents).
*   **Dimensions:** The image is in portrait orientation.
*   **Background:** The background is a solid dark navy blue with subtle, faint geometric line patterns or shapes that add texture without distracting from the text.

---

### **Text Content (Word-for-Word)**

**Header Section:**
*   **Main Logo/Brand Name:** `KOZY` (Large, bold, serif font, Gold)
*   **Sub-brand:** `PREMIUM DRYCLEANING & LAUNDRY` (Smaller, sans-serif, all caps, Gold)

**Offer Section:**
*   **Headline:** `15% OFF` (Very large, bold, Gold)
*   **Sub-headline:** `your first premium clean` ("your first" is white script/cursive font; "premium clean" is gold italicized serif font)
*   **Description:** `Dry cleaning, wash & fold, and shoe care — collected at your door and returned immaculate.` (White sans-serif text)

**Features List (Centered):**
*   `FREE PICKUP & DELIVERY •`
*   `48-HOUR TURNAROUND • EXPERT GARMENT CARE`

**Testimonial Quote (Right side, next to photo):**
*   `"Uncompromising care. Exceptional convenience."` (White italicized serif font)

**Call-to-Action Button (Large Yellow/Gold Bar):**
*   `Book at kozycare.ng` (Bold, dark navy/black text)
*   `OR WHATSAPP +234 803 175 5230` (Smaller text below it)

**Bottom Left (QR Code Area):**
*   Above QR Code: `SCAN · BOOK · RELAX`

**Bottom Right (Contact Details):**
*   `KOZY CARE`
*   `No. 20, Westyde Drive, Ogombo, Lagos`
*   `kozygarmentcare@gmail.com`

---

### **Visual Elements**

*   **The Woman:**
    *   **Appearance:** She is a Black woman with dark hair pulled back neatly into a low bun or ponytail. She has a warm, welcoming smile showing her teeth. She appears to be wearing makeup (defined eyes, neutral lip color).
    *   **Pose:** She is facing slightly to her left (the viewer's right), looking directly at the camera with a friendly expression.
    *   **Clothing:** She wears a black top or dress with an intricate gold or yellow pattern (looks like embroidery or print) on the shoulder/chest area visible in the frame.
    *   **Framing:** She is positioned inside a thin, circular or arched gold border/frame on the left-center of the lower half of the flyer.
    *   **What she's holding:** She is holding a stack of folded, crisp blue garments (likely dress shirts or similar items) tied neatly with a matching blue ribbon or band.

*   **Logo:**
    *   The primary logo is the word **"KOZY"** in a distinctive, elegant serif typeface with high contrast between thick and thin strokes. There is no separate graphical icon; the wordmark serves as the logo.

*   **QR Code:**
    *   Located in the bottom left corner, inside a white square with rounded corners. The code itself is black and white pixelated pattern.

*   **Discount Offer:**
    *   **15% OFF** your first premium clean. This is the dominant message of the flyer.

*   **Contact Information:**
    *   **Website:** kozycare.ng
    *   **Phone/WhatsApp:** +234 803 175 5230
    *   **Email:** kozycaregarmentcare@gmail.com
    *   **Physical Address:** No. 20, Westyde Drive, Ogombo, Lagos

### **Color Palette Summary**
*   **Primary Background:** Deep Navy Blue (#0a192f or similar)
*   **Primary Accent/Text:** Metallic Gold / Mustard Yellow (#d4af37 or #c5a059 range)
*   **Secondary Text:** White
*   **Button Background:** Bright Gold/Yellow
*   **Photo Element:** Skin tones, Black/Gold clothing, Bright Blue (for the garment stack)
